priority_rule: Ball C (external pay) outranks architecture. Jobs that do not move L1-L3 are deferred.

levels.L1: Settlement Sync runs; meter honest at 0; buy routers reach Stripe
levels.L2: Webhook to fulfil proven on one product (self-test not counted as revenue)

jobs.title: Inventory live Payment Links vs approved catalog
jobs.acceptance: Single source of truth file listing every live plink, amount_nzd, sku, and whether Settlement Sync watches it

jobs.title: Settlement Sync dry-run produces honest zero meter
jobs.acceptance: Workflow or script exits 0 with verified_external_revenue_nzd=0 and no fabricated sessions

jobs.title: Primary CTA surface points only at approved live plink
jobs.acceptance: dreamledger.org storefront and /mtg primary CTA resolve to one approved Stripe Payment Link; no dead or test links in the path

jobs.title: Webhook signature + idempotency self-test
jobs.acceptance: Signed test event processed once; duplicate replay is no-op; evidence written; not counted as revenue

jobs.title: Digital fulfil path for one SKU (wall or diagnostic)
jobs.acceptance: After simulated or test paid session, buyer can claim deliverable; operator_required=false for that SKU

jobs.title: Ball C — first external live purchase
jobs.acceptance: Stranger completes live Checkout; Settlement Sync records matching session; fulfil completes; fossil sealed; meter increments only from that evidence
jobs.note: Cannot be closed by agents alone. Requires real external buyer. Agents may only prepare surfaces and evidence paths.

jobs.title: Post-pay alert on fulfil failure
jobs.acceptance: Paid-but-unfulfilled state raises durable alert artifact within defined SLA; no silent drop

jobs.title: Second external pay without architecture change
jobs.acceptance: Second independent external session settles and fulfils using the same path as REV-010

jobs.title: Neon heartbeat persistence cutover
jobs.acceptance: Write + read-back of cortex_heartbeat on Neon with evidence; recovery adapter inspect mode passes
jobs.note: Parallel to revenue. Does not close L3.

jobs.title: Cloudflare preview full route probe
jobs.acceptance: Preview deployment returns contract statuses for all routes in CLOUDFLARE-ROUTE-PARITY-CONTRACT; commerce routes remain 503 until ported
jobs.note: Parallel to revenue. Does not close L3.

claim_rule: One agent claims one OPEN job. Write evidence path before marking done. Never mark REV-010 done without external fossil.
